purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/registry evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official TKGM parcel inquiry is public and supports geographic parcel display; local metropolitan viewer documents planning/buildings rather than parcel vectors. Native query schema/full polygon feature access and WUP-point sample were not verified. Direct city site request returned 403 from shell; official web content loads and describes the application, so this is an access limitation, not source absence.
registryAssessment: TKGM official provincial organization directory explicitly lists Kahramanmaraş Kadastro Müdürlüğü, and the official parcel-inquiry service identifies TKGM as its operator. The Kahramanmaraş Metropolitan Municipality separately documents its City Information System.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official TKGM directory lists Kahramanmaraş Kadastro Müdürlüğü under the Gaziantep regional directorate.
First-party TKGM page for the local Kahramanmaraş Cadastre Directorate.
TKGM describes its public parcel inquiry service and administrative parcel search.
Municipal e-services page says the 3D City Guide provides building models, district/municipality boundaries, master plans and route data; it does not document cadastral parcel geometry.
Municipal City Information System describes an integrated digital city model and Kent Rehberi/planning modules.

searchQueries.result: Official TKGM parcel inquiry is the public parcel application. No city-specific anonymous full-vector response was established; municipal City Information System is broader city modeling/planning.

geometryDecision: No complete full polygon with a safely validated native parcel identifier was retained. The public viewer advertises/displays parcel geometry, but an exact WUP-point sample was not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: TKGM parcel inquiry is Turkey-wide; the locally listed Kahramanmaraş Cadastre Directorate is the named custodian. No local-city completeness is independently measured.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service supports parcel search/display by administrative location and parcel number; city 3D guide shows buildings, boundaries, zoning and routes. No complete parcel polygon response was returned or retained.

attempts.observation: Direct shell request received 403. Official web inspection/search content still exposes the City Information System description; 403 is an access limitation and not evidence that the service is absent.

remainingUncertainty: Whether TKGM permits anonymous full-polygon download/API responses for this location; whether municipal GIS exposes a separate cadastral parcel feature layer.
